def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

                c += 1
                continue

            while c < w and edge[c] != 0:
                run.append(edge[c])
                c += 1
            runs.append(run)

    lookup = {value: (run, index)
              for run in runs
              for index, value in enumerate(run)}

    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[r][c]
            if not value or value not in lookup:
                continue

                continue
            run, index = lookup[value]
            start = c - index

                q = start + j
